title: Show exact linear lift-up prevents automatic physical-background transfer
statement: For ordinary forced Navier–Stokes with v=b+u and g=b_t-nu Delta b+P[(b.grad)b], perturbations include P[(u.grad)b], absent from the accepted extra-skew-advection model. With b=A(t)cos(2pi y)e1 and initial linearized perturbation e2 cos(2pi l z), l>=1, the exact solution has u2=e^(-4pi^2 nu l^2 t)cos(2pi l z), u3=0, and u1=2pi sin(2pi y)cos(2pi l z) integral_0^t A(s)e^(-4pi^2 nu[(l^2+1)(t-s)+l^2s])ds. Every nonnegative smooth pulse of action S has ||u1(tau)||Lp>=2pi c_(p,l) S e^(-4pi^2 nu(l^2+1)tau). Thus a fixed physical fiber has at least linear action growth at short times and cannot inherit Dots’ action-independent bound for the different generator. This is an exact one-shear linear transfer obstruction, not a nonlinear or all-controller impossibility and not a rejection of the full accepted controlled-PDE result.
